title: Level Up In-Game Earnings Without Losing Players
prompt: Build a non-intrusive in-game advertising placement puzzle. The player is shown a 3D game environment (top-down view of a racing track, city street, sports arena) and must drag ad units onto surfaces — billboards, jerseys, loading screens — while keeping an 'immersion meter' high and an 'revenue meter' rising. Placing ads on HUD or blocking gameplay drops immersion instantly. Bold sports-broadcast visual style with animated crowd reactions.
